title: End-screen bed, 20 s (under Zoo's voice-over)
description: The theme's groove, light, under the end screen's voice-over: no vibes until the motif lands on D minor at 18.0 s; ends at exactly 20.0 s.
usage: End-aligned, under Zoo's voice-over: place it so it ends with the video (for a shorter end screen, start later and fade in) and duck it with scripts/audio/duck.py. Bed level (-26 LUFS-S). With nobody speaking, use endscreen-music.
selfReview: Six bars of light groove, a turnaround, then the motif lands on D minor at 18.0 s and rings out to exactly 20.0 s, at bed level (-26 LUFS-S) for Zoo's call to action. Critic round 1 (2026-11-24): it was the worst bed under his voice (band-audibility index 0.67-0.69, under speech-shaped noise at 0.76). The vibes now rest until the bar-7 motif, the hats and pulse came down (-10 and -15 dB, the pulse an octave up), the bass is the dark finger-plucked one, the bus dips 1.25 and 2 kHz and takes 2.5 dB off below 150 Hz, and the kick's beater is quieter. With the band-split duck the index is 0.83 (speech-shaped noise at the same loudness: 0.69), the 1-4 kHz median SNR 22.6 dB and 8 % of speech frames under 3 dB there (28-29 % before); on the phone model it loses 5.3 LU, about what Zoo loses. With nobody speaking use `endscreen-music` (-18 LUFS-I).
